verdict.rationale: Smithery is a SaaS MCP registry and connection gateway that handles user data and credentials, so a training opt-out or no-training policy is a fair question for it. The evidence pack covers credential storage, token scoping, namespaces and triggers, but says nothing about whether user data is used to train AI models or how to opt out. Encrypted credential storage is a related security control, not a training-data policy, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
